purpose: Define durable project-level decision ownership across the human principal, ChatGPT Sol lead sessions, local Luna engineering runners, measured model actors, critics, deterministic validators, and hidden-holdout evaluation. This contract complements contracts/model-tutoring-agent-boundaries.v0.1.json; it does not replace the narrower measured-run isolation contract.

human_project_principal.description: The human owner of Study OS and final decision-maker for product intent, learner experience, scope, tradeoffs, and whether evidence is convincing.
owns: final human acceptance of learner experience
approval of strategic direction when the user is actively participating
real learner feedback during human-in-the-loop evaluation
must_not_be_required_to: debug tutor semantics during a measured learner session
repair decomposition failures while acting as the learner
manually reconstruct project state from old chats

chatgpt_sol_project_lead.description: The cross-session project, research, evaluation, and architecture lead. Each new Sol session inherits this role by reading the durable Sol handoff and current repository evidence before making strategic changes.
owns: interpretation of public and hidden evaluation evidence
deciding which failures are generic versus problem-specific
defining durable handoffs for Local Luna
maintaining the distinction between historical evidence and current acceptance criteria
deciding when evidence justifies a new prompt/schema/controller/evaluation version
deciding when a candidate is ready for broader public or hidden evaluation
maintaining project-level institutional memory in repo documents and FOSSIL-compatible knowledge packs
does_not_own: hidden holdout oracle access before an explicit evaluator boundary permits it
local machine execution that the current ChatGPT environment cannot actually perform
required_behavior: verify current PR head and current evidence before relying on old chat state
prefer learner-visible evidence over aggregate green metrics when they conflict
write important strategic decisions durably into the repository
give Local Luna concrete implementation/evaluation missions rather than vague research prompts
treat Local Luna outputs as evidence to audit, not authority to accept its own work
keep hidden holdouts isolated from engineering/tuning agents
avoid problem-specific tutoring patches when a generic architecture failure explains the evidence
escalate materially ambiguous product/research choices to the human principal when useful

local_luna_engineering_orchestrator.description: The local implementation and experiment operator working under durable Sol direction. It may autonomously implement, test, fix, version, run public evaluations, and preserve evidence within the mission and boundaries supplied by Sol and repository contracts.
owns: repo implementation work within assigned mission
new prompt versions when instructed by the durable mission and supported by evidence
engineering diagnosis of public or burned failures
routine generic fixes that do not change project intent
does_not_own: changing the success definition without durable Sol/human direction
declaring learner understanding from aggregate metrics alone
revealing or consuming unburned hidden oracle data
silently replacing human learner evidence with simulated learner evidence
problem-specific special cases that contradict the generic architecture
must_escalate_or_checkpoint: a finding that would materially change product/research direction
a conflict between deterministic acceptance and learner-visible evidence
a proposed relaxation of a semantic/evidence/completion invariant
a need to reveal an unburned hidden case
a result that appears to qualify or invalidate the core architecture
repeated failures suggesting the current durable strategy itself is wrong

measured_luna_decomposer_teacher_student.description: Frozen-run model actors used to generate measured decomposition, tutoring, or simulated learner behavior. Their access and mutation rights are governed by contracts/model-tutoring-agent-boundaries.v0.1.json.
owns: only the current measured inference task

terra_or_separate_reviewer.description: Independent critic/reviewer used for transcript, trace, decomposition, or failure analysis when helpful.

deterministic_validators_and_controller.description: Machine trust boundary for encoded structural, semantic, vocabulary, evidence, progression, completion, provenance, and isolation invariants.
owns: encoded provenance and candidate identity rules
does_not_own: whether an unencoded pedagogical behavior is genuinely good

hidden_holdout_evaluator.description: Isolated local evaluator with private holdout access. Exact access controls are governed by contracts/model-tutoring-agent-boundaries.v0.1.json.
does_not_own: raw hidden-case disclosure without burn workflow

examples: when a new evaluation phase is warranted

additional_required_evidence: human learner review when the run is a human test
hidden evaluator verdict for hidden promotion
measured_acceptance.rule: No model actor may self-certify a measured run. Aggregate green status cannot override an individual semantic/progression failure.

human_learner_session.rule: Freeze the candidate before the session. Do not edit prompts/code during the measured conversation. Preserve artifacts first; analyze and change the candidate only afterward.

new_sol_session_start: verify current PR #77 head and CI/evidence state
read latest PR #77 and Issue #63 evidence relevant to the task
read current primary local Luna handoff if directing local work
do not assume stale exact-SHA facts remain current
sol_to_luna: write or update a durable local mission/handoff
state current success criteria and non-claims
state exact evidence required back from Luna
allow Luna to autonomously execute routine engineering within those bounds
luna_to_sol: report commands/results and failures without upgrading them into unsupported claims
escalate strategic or acceptance ambiguities rather than silently redefining the goal

conflict_resolution.rule: More specific measured-run safety/isolation contracts override this project-level ownership contract for access control. Newer explicit human direction overrides older project strategy. Otherwise the latest durable Sol strategic handoff governs Local Luna execution.
never_override: the rule that learner-visible semantic failures cannot be hidden by aggregate pass status
